title: PrivateTeamRecord
description: One revision of one team in the private team store (ADR-014 section 4): the PokePaste in the engine's canonical form, the hashes that identify it, its status, tags and labels. The data class is always private. A record is content-addressed: record_hash is SHA-256 of the JCS bytes of this object; supersedes_record_hash links a revision to the one before it. The paste's round trip through the pinned engine, both team hashes, revision 1 having no predecessor, sorted and unique tags and unique label ids are enforced by the reader (the contract profile cannot compute them); so are the snapshot-level rules (unique team_id, unique canonical_team_hash among active records).

data_class.description: Always private. The data-class guard refuses this label everywhere except at the exact corpus sample paths it lists (ADR-014 section 10).

team_id.description: A 128-bit random id as 32 lower-case hex characters; stable across revisions.

revision.description: The revision, 1 for the first and plus 1 per edit.

supersedes_record_hash.description: Null for revision 1; otherwise the record_hash of the previous revision.

team_hash.description: SHA-256 of the JCS bytes of the team's set array, in paste order (ADR-013).

canonical_team_hash.description: SHA-256 of the JCS bytes of the set array sorted by species id, ties broken by the set's JCS bytes (ADR-013).

paste.description: The team as PokePaste text, exactly as the engine exports it.

status.description: Whether the team is in use.

tags.description: The owner's tags, sorted and unique (reader-enforced).

labels.description: Label values in the form of ADR-013's TeamRecord labels; label ids are unique (reader-enforced).

items.description: A label's value for this team.
